query: SELECT $1::BIGINT AS "user_id!", $2::BIGINT AS "repo_id!", BOOL_OR(can_view) AS "can_view!", BOOL_OR(can_backup) AS "can_backup!", BOOL_OR(can_modify_schedules) AS "can_modify_schedules!", BOOL_OR(can_extract) AS "can_extract!", BOOL_OR(can_delete) AS "can_delete!" FROM ( SELECT can_view, can_backup, can_modify_schedules, can_extract, can_delete FROM repo_permissions WHERE user_id = $1 AND repo_id = $2 UNION ALL SELECT g.can_view, g.can_backup, g.can_modify_schedules, g.can_extract, g.can_delete FROM group_repo_permissions g JOIN user_groups ug ON ug.group_id = g.group_id WHERE ug.user_id = $1 AND g.repo_id = $2 ) grants HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
